She holds a small black plush toy in her hands. Behind her, a large orange plush toy rests against a plain off-white wall under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The girl stands up on the bed and crawls towards a large white light switch on the wall. She repeatedly toggles the switch, causing the room to flicker between bright illumination and a dimly lit state. Another slightly taller child in light-colored patterned pajamas joins her, and they both interact with the switch. (3) The scene shifts to the toddler in a yellow shirt and plaid pants. She continues to play with the switch and a small, illuminated animal-shaped night light on a bedside table. Eventually, she is shown lying down under a duvet in a darkened room before the final logo animation.
